author: gpt-6
visual_review: The original has an upright hull, long cockpit and a diagonal double paddle; the rejected drawing rotated the hull and turned both blade ends into rings. Returned the hull to its upright axis, elongated the cockpit and replaced the rings with capped paddle tips. Native 48px light and dark previews inspected.
omissions: The diagonal shaft is occluded by the hull and cockpit to preserve their openings.
construction_reference: Lucide kayak: hull and double-ended paddle topology
